BrochureContent.Content:
An expansive detached residence extending to c. 2,217 sq. ft / 206 m² set on c. 0.9 acres with significant outbuildings in a prime location 

Location

Orchard Grove is superbly located on the Dublin Road in Ballyoulster, Celbridge, Co. Kildare, in one of the most sought-after residential locations in Kildare. Set back from the road on approximately 0.9 acres, this exceptional property enjoys a prime location while being just minutes from the bustling town of Celbridge and all the amenities it has to offer.

This exceptionally large and spacious five-bedroom detached bungalow extends to approximately 2,217 sq. ft. and provides generous and spacious accommodation comprising five bedrooms, three bathrooms and three reception rooms, together with a kitchen. To the rear, a selection of outbuildings and sheds extending to over 2,000 sq. ft. further enhances the property's potential and attractiveness, offering a multitude of potential uses.

This high profile property enjoys an enviable setting adjoining O'Hanlon Park, with excellent sporting and recreational facilities on its doorstep, including golf, padel and football. The renowned Orchard Garden Centre is located opposite the property, while Barnhall Rugby Club , Kildare Innovation Campus, the state laboratories at Back Weston, Weston Airport and Lucan Golf Club all located within less than 5 minutes of the property.

The surrounding area is rich in heritage and attractions, with the historic Castletown House and its extensive parklands and walking trails located nearby. The village of Celbridge is within 2 km with its excellent selection of restaurants, leisure facilities and local amenities.

Orchard Grove is ideally positioned for commuters, with excellent access to the M4 and N7, providing convenient connections to Dublin City Centre and Dublin Airport, which are approximately 35 minutes away by car, traffic permitting. The generous grounds, landmark location and peaceful setting combine to offer the discerning purchaser a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of both worlds — a private country-style setting with extensive space, while having the convenience of Celbridge's amenities and excellent transport links close at hand. With its substantial accommodation and outbuildings, generous site size and landmark location, Orchard Grove provides an ideal opportunity to create a wonderful family home or the potential for the renovation and remodelling of the existing dwelling and outbuildings in one of Co. Kildare's most desirable residential areas.
